_comment: Composite indexes for the queries in store.js. Single-field indexes are
created automatically by Firestore and are not listed here.
Everyone on the team sees every lead, so the lead and activity feeds are
plain orderBy() queries with no where() clause — those need no composite.
Only the two queries below combine a filter with a sort.

indexes._use: activity on one lead: where(leadId) + orderBy(at)
